{{Top|leg}}
'''Location transponders''' were installed in [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[IC-M General Utility Droid]]s. They kept track of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as it moved through [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] and since they were difficult to remove, their presence reduced the chance of the unit being stolen or vandalized.
